Name: Ravi Jasuja
Designation: Director, Translational Research and Discovery, BWH, Harvard Medical School
Bio: Ravi is a Founder of Plaksha University. Ravi leads a transdisciplinary research program and has made major contributions to science over the past two decades at the interface of engineering, biophysics, and cell signaling for studying diverse biological problems. He is also the Co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Function Promoting Therapies LLC.
Education: Fellow, Biophysics/ Physiology, Albert Einstein College of Medicine | PhD, Biophysics, University of Hawaii | Btech, IIT Delhi
